Below it, a centred dedication title block in several lines, then a centred italic salutation line, then one body paragraph in italic with a large initial M. main_text.head: Inclytæ ac Florentissimæ Civitatis GRONINGANÆ Proceribus Dn. CONSULIBUS ac SENATORIBUS Nobilissimis, Consultissimis, Amplissimis, Patribus Patriæ,

p.i: Magnis verisimisque elogiis consentientis vox Eruditorum celebrat Historiam, quod Origines, Leges, Instituta, Mores, Res gestas gentium diversarum pandens, civilis prudentiæ velut Promptuarium aliquod locupletissimum præstet atque aperiat. Quam laudem cum quævis jure sibi suo arrogare Historia possit, tum eam eximiam meritissimo suo vindicat illa, quæ Reip. domesticæ Antiquitates, Iura, Privilegia, Facta, Formamque complexa, ceu Sacrum Depositum custodit, posterisque propagat. Siquidem Nosse

page.notes: The decorative border at the top and the faint "Digitized by Google" watermark at the lower right are not transcribed.
